title: FE/BE developer (Medior)
description:
Our mission
LOGEX is at the forefront of healthcare analytics in Europe, transforming data into actionable insights to address the complex challenge of managing costs while improving clinical outcomes. Headquartered in Amsterdam, LOGEX boasts an international team of over 450 members, supporting over 1,000 public and private healthcare providers in making data-driven decisions that enhance patient outcomes and make quality care more affordable for everyone.
Are you passionate about both backend and frontend development, and are C#/.NET and Angular/TypeScript no strangers to you? Do you enjoy working with Microsoft technologies and the SCRUM methodology? And at the same time, do you want your work to make sense and the final product to truly help people? Then we might be a great match!
We are looking for a
Backend/Frontend Developer
to join a team developing
Costing
– an application used by hospitals to allocate costs and calculate the real unit costs of healthcare services.
What will you do at Logex?
Develop the
Costing
application, helping hospitals better understand and manage healthcare costs.
Be part of the
Costing (CST) team
, focused on cost calculations, data processing, and insights for hospitals across Europe.
Collaborate on the design and implementation of new features – from cost models and configuration, through data visualization, to support of analytical reports.
Participate in maintaining and further developing existing parts of the Costing product (both frontend and backend).
What will be part of your role?
Backend development of Web APIs in .NET – business logic for calculations, working with domain objects, calling internal services.
Frontend development of a SPA application in Angular/TypeScript – setting up models, tables, filters, dashboards, and interactive screens for hospital users.
Cooperation with dedicated DB developers – you’ll understand the data and how it’s used in the code, but you don’t need to be a database specialist.
Writing unit and integration tests and participating in code reviews.
Basic work with CI/CD pipelines (builds, releases, logs) and environments in Kubernetes/Docker.
Collaboration on integrations with other Logex systems (e.g. authentication, user settings, shared configurations).

Requirements:
What do we expect from you?
Are you an enthusiastic developer with at least
2 years of experience in Angular/TypeScript
development, or in another modern JavaScript framework, and are you interested in switching to Angular?
Experience with
C#/.NET is also a big advantage
—especially Web API and backend services—since backend work will be part of your role.
And you also have:
Ideally knowledge of
SOLID principles, Unit Testing, IoC/DI
Experience with
REST APIs
Basic experience with
relational databases
– understanding tables, data models, and simple queries (advanced topics are handled by the DB team)
User-level knowledge of
Git
Ability to communicate in
English
with colleagues from the Netherlands, the UK, or Scandinavian countries
What kind of person will feel comfortable in our team?
You enjoy working in a smaller team but can also work independently.
You want to learn, aren’t afraid to ask questions, and like sharing your knowledge with others.
You are communicative and comfortable discussing requirements.
Communicating in English with international colleagues doesn’t stress you out.
Taking responsibility and owning a part of the product in the future is something you’re comfortable with.
More about LOGEX
What we offer
Work/life balance
– flexible working hours, home office, 25 days of vacation, 5 sick days
Budget for education
, travel to the Netherlands, or individual hardware
Company-wide and team events (Christmas and summer parties, beers, cupping, breakfasts, movie nights, family days…)
Pension contribution
of 5% of your monthly salary
Fully stocked kitchen and fridge with great food, fruit, vegetables, and a sweet drawer – coffee lovers will feel at home too
Meal allowance, leisure benefit cards (Multisport/Pluxee)
Relax zone with a massage chair, regular yoga sessions, and a game room with table football
Beautiful offices in the center of
Brno (Nové sady)
Contact us!
You can apply via the button below and upload your CV. For more information, or in case you have any
questions, you can contact Michaela Knápková at
michaela.knapkova@logex.com

As we strive to create a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic, we encourage everyone to apply.

title: Business Development Representative Real-World Evidence
description:
Our mission
LOGEX is at the forefront of healthcare analytics in Europe, transforming data into actionable insights to address the complex challenge of managing costs while improving clinical outcomes. Headquartered in Amsterdam, LOGEX boasts an international team of over 450 members, supporting over 1,000 public and private healthcare providers in making data-driven decisions that enhance patient outcomes and make quality care more affordable for everyone.
Your impact and responsibilities
As a Business Development Representative (BDR) at LOGEX, you will play a crucial role in driving sales and expanding our network. Our solutions are widely used across Europe, with market shares ranging from 20% to 60% depending on the country. You will be instrumental in delivering real-world evidence to the eco healthcare system.
Generate and manage a robust sales pipeline, focusing on the life science sector.
Develop new business opportunities , working closely with business development managers in established clients.
Position LOGEX's leading-edge RWE observatories and healthcare solutions effectively to prospective clients.
Form strategic partnerships and manage client journeys through contracts.
Your team
The Real-World Evidence division is growing and is in full swing. The team is primarily responsible for gaining insights into the use and effect of (expensive) drugs. In view of the aging population, a significant increase in drug use and new drugs is expected it is essential to have a very clear picture of the exact effect of medicines. The insights and studies of the Real-World Evidence team offer a solution for this.

Requirements:
Your profile
3-5 years of experience in healthcare and the pharmaceutical sector, with a strong background in digital solutions selling and/or SaaS.
In-depth understanding of procurement processes and RFP frameworks.
Established network within the pharmaceutical sector (preferred)
Proven track record of success in value selling and pipeline generation.
Excellent IT user skills, including proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and Salesforce.
Why LOGEX?
Healthcare today is more tailored and more effective than ever before. However, with these improvements, come complexity. The burden of healthcare spending weighs heavily on economies, while the sheer number of options physicians and patients can choose from leads to uncertainty and unacceptable variations in clinical outcomes. At LOGEX, we have one superpower: data analysis. We choose to use this superpower to help address today’s healthcare issues by turning data into better healthcare. Besides a purpose-driven workplace, we offer you:
An excellent compensation package (salary, holiday allowance, NS Business Card, phone and internet allowance)
25 vacation days (based on full-time employment) to recharge, with the option to purchase additional days
An informal working environment with motivated colleagues
The possibility to work in a hybrid setup
A laptop and everything you need to set up a comfortable and ergonomic home office
Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy
Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp
Regular after-work drinks and many more social events

title: Senior RevOps Specialist (Technical)
description:
Our mission
At LOGEX, we improve healthcare by turning complex data into actionable insights. Our products help hospitals, life-science companies, and other healthcare stakeholders make better decisions—so care becomes more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. We work in a fast-growing, international environment where ownership, quality, and collaboration matter.
The role
We are looking for a Senior RevOps Specialist (Technical) to design, govern, and scale automation across a complex go-to-market (GTM) landscape. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will own the technical foundation of our RevOps automation—ensuring reliability, performance, and clarity across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Marketing.
You will lead advanced Salesforce automation (Flows, Orchestrator, Apex Actions), configure and operationalize Agentforce, and set standards that balance speed with stability. This role combines deep technical expertise with the ability to translate complexity into practical solutions for diverse stakeholders.
Your impact and responsibilities
Automation architecture
Design, document, and maintain advanced Salesforce Flows (subflows, Orchestrator, fault handling, transaction control).
Define scalable patterns, guardrails, and performance best practices for bulk actions
Apex Actions leadership
Develop and execute on invocable Apex methods, ensuring bulkification, logging, observability, and test coverage.
Drive code reviews for admin-owned integrations and automation.
Governance & reliability
Establish admin standards (naming, versioning, audit trails).
Migrate legacy automation (e.g. Process Builder) to perform, maintainable Flows.
Proactively manage errors, failures, and system health.
Setting up price books
Release & change management
Own sandbox strategy, UAT, deployment processes, and post-release validation.
Enable and support end users after releases.
Data model & security
Steward the Salesforce data model, permissions, sharing, validation rules, and deduplication.
Run periodic access and data-quality reviews.
Stakeholder partnership
Translate business needs into robust technical designs.
Produce clear documentation and runbooks.
Support onboarding/ technical enablement for RevOps partners and commercial teams on tool tech stack.

Requirements:
Your profile
5+ years of Salesforce administration experience in high-growth or enterprise GTM environments.
Advanced expertise in Salesforce Flow (including Orchestrator), exception handling, and performance tuning.
Strong experience executing and governing Apex Actions (invocable Apex, callouts, test classes).
Solid understanding of Salesforce data models, SOQL, and deployment/release best practices.
A structured mindset with the ability to explain complex topics in clear, non-technical language.
Nice to have
Experience with CPQ solutions (DealHub or Salesforce Revenue Cloud).
Familiarity with forecasting or revenue intelligence tools such as Clari or Gong.
Exposure analytics tools (Tableau, Looker) and SQL.
Hands-on experience configuring Agentforce (policies, guardrails, monitoring).
Salesforce certifications: Administrator
Your first 90 days
Stabilize core automation:
Reduce Flow and Apex Action error rates and improve execution performance; retire high-risk legacy automation.
Deliver RevOps impact:
Ship 1–2 high-impact improvements, such as pipeline hygiene scoring or quote-approval optimization.
Why LOGEX?
An excellent compensation package (salary, holiday allowance, NS Business Card, phone and internet allowance)
25 vacation days (based on full-time employment) to recharge, with the option to purchase additional days
An informal working environment with motivated colleagues
The possibility to work in a hybrid setup
A laptop and everything you need to set up a comfortable and ergonomic home office
Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy
Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp
Regular after-work drinks and many more social events

title: Sales Development Representative DACH (m/w/d)
description:
Unsere Mission
LOGEX ist führend in der Gesundheitsanalytik in Europa. Indem LOGEX Daten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse umwandelt, trägt LOGEX dazu bei, die komplexe Herausforderung im Gesundheitswesen zu lösen: Kostenmanagement bei gleichzeitiger Verbesserung der klinischen Ergebnisse.
Ihre Wirkung und Aufgaben
Bei LOGEX spielen unsere Sales Development Representatives eine zentrale Rolle bei der Umsatzsteigerung und dem Ausbau unseres Netzwerks. Unsere Lösungen werden europaweit eingesetzt. Je nach Land verfügt Logex über einen Marktanteil zwischen 20 % und 60 % und Zugang zu einem soliden Kundenstamm. Das Unternehmen bietet Finanzanalysen und Benchmarking-Dienstleistungen zur Unterstützung der Prozessoptimierung an.
Im Zuge unserer Expansion in Europa suchen wir einen erfahrenen SDR, der LOGEX in der DACH-Region auf die nächste Stufe bringt.
Diese Rolle umfasst sowohl die Neukundenbetreuung als auch das Account Management. Sie arbeiten eng mit Beratern bestehender Kunden zusammen und suchen aktiv nach neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
Unsere Financial Analytics-Lösung ist eine hochmoderne SaaS-Plattform. Wir erwarten von Ihnen als erfolgreicher Bewerber/in sowohl SaaS- als auch Vertriebserfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, die für die Positionierung unserer Produkte und Dienstleistungen erforderlich ist.
Ihr Team
Mit Hauptsitz in Amsterdam und einem internationalen Team von über 450 Mitarbeitern unterstützt LOGEX über 1.000 öffentliche und private Gesundheitsdienstleister bei datenbasierten Entscheidungen, die die Patientenergebnisse weltweit verbessern und die bestmögliche Versorgung für alle erschwinglicher machen.

Requirements:
Stellenanforderungen
1–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder im Analytics-Vertrieb mit Erfahrung im Vertrieb digitaler Lösungen und/oder SaaS
Kenntnisse in Softwarebeschaffungsprozessen und im Umgang mit Ausschreibungsrahmen
Etabliertes Netzwerk im Gesundheitswesen, z. B. zu Krankenhäusern, Gesundheitsdienstleistern, Behörden, Pharmaunternehmen usw.
Solide Erfolgsbilanz im Value Selling
Kenntnisse der Führungsebene im Sektor und den strategischen Treibern der Branche
Fähigkeit, strategische Partnerschaften aufzubauen und Kundenbeziehungen vertraglich zu managen
Ausgezeichnete IT-Anwenderkenntnisse – PowerPoint, Excel, Salesforce
Die Stelle bietet ein hervorragendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket, wie es von einem multinationalen Unternehmen erwartet wird. Weitere Details erhalten Sie im Vorstellungsgespräch.
Warum LOGEX?
Das Gehalt wird mit einem 80:20-Provisionsplan (fix: variabel) basierend auf der Erreichung festgelegter Ziele vereinbart. Das Gehalt entspricht der Erfahrung des/der erfolgreichen Bewerbers/in und den aktuellen Marktbedingungen.
Dies ist eine spannende Gelegenheit, die Marke LOGEX europaweit auszubauen und unsere bestehenden und zukünftigen Kunden bei der Steigerung ihrer finanziellen Effizienz zu unterstützen.
Kontaktieren Sie uns!
Bewerben Sie sich über den untenstehenden Button und laden Sie Ihren Lebenslauf hoch. Für weitere Informationen oder bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Wesley Schreuder unter Wesley.schreuder@logex.com.
